---
title: Media
---

Images and media elements are common in blog content. The sanitizer preserves
them but narrows their attribute surface to what feed readers actually honor.

Padding: responsive images use `srcset` and `sizes`, which readers like
Feedbin honor. `loading="lazy"` is harmless even where unsupported. We don't
allow `autoplay` on audio/video because surprise audio is a cardinal sin in
feed readers — some of which render feed content inside a fixed preview pane.

## Image with responsive attrs

<img
  src="https://cdn.example.com/img.jpg"
  srcset="https://cdn.example.com/img.jpg 1x, https://cdn.example.com/img@2x.jpg 2x"
  sizes="(min-width: 600px) 600px, 100vw"
  alt="Responsive demo"
  width="600"
  height="400"
  loading="lazy"
  decoding="async"
/>

## Picture with sources

<picture>
  <source srcset="https://cdn.example.com/img.webp" type="image/webp" />
  <img src="https://cdn.example.com/img.jpg" alt="Picture demo" />
</picture>

## Video — controls allowed, autoplay stripped

<video
  controls
  autoplay
  muted
  loop
  width="640"
  height="360"
  poster="https://cdn.example.com/poster.jpg"
>
  <source src="https://cdn.example.com/clip.mp4" type="video/mp4" />
</video>

## Audio — controls allowed

<audio controls src="https://cdn.example.com/clip.mp3"></audio>
